scope: Independent CSV, input-identity and production-function manufactured-field review

independent_checks.reduction_rounding_context: Difference in recomputing an approximately 4.01e5 Pa/s RMS, not physical error

load_observation_gap.explanation: JSphCpu.cpp conditionally writes the load telemetry together with nonzero total force/rate/viscosity results. Exact force cancellation can suppress telemetry; this is not zero applied confinement. Production code was not changed.

decision: First test the existing stress-rate gradient switch alone in fresh bounded dynamics, preserving the original load. Do not implement multiple candidate changes together or interpret an instantaneous affine improvement as a Cryer peak-accuracy acceptance.
limits: This companion disables drainage/viscosity/damping only in its frozen manufactured fixture, not in formal input or a time-evolving physical run.
The current mixed-density nonzero-pore-pressure force formula is not algebraically exact for arbitrary constant total stress; the small measured residual is reported rather than hidden.
Uncorrected density continuity remains unchanged. This review does not approve a density-integration redesign.
No new external-load operator, shifting scheme or physical accuracy claim is accepted here.
